User Story Number: US-041
User Story Summary: Configure Page Size for Data Grid
User Story Description:
As a user, I want to change the number of records displayed per page so that I can adjust the view to show more or fewer items based on my current needs.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given the data grid is populated
When the user selects a different page size option (e.g., changing from 10 to 50 rows

And the pagination controls should recalculate to reflect the new total number of pages.

User Story Number: US-042
User Story Summary: Navigate to Last Page of Data
User Story Description:
As a user, I want to quickly jump to the last page of the dataset so that I can view the final records without clicking through every intermediate page.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given a paginated data set
When the user selects the action to navigate to the last page
Then the system should display the correct records corresponding to the final page index.

---

User Story Number: US-043
User Story Summary: Display Total Record Count and Current Page
User Story Description:
As a user, I want to see the total record count and current page number so that I am aware of my progress through the dataset.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given the pagination component is active
Then the UI must display the current page number
And the UI must display the total record count or total number of pages for context.

---

User Story Number: US-044
User Story Summary: Handle Empty Data States and Edge Cases
User Story Description:
As a user, I want the system to handle empty or minimal data gracefully so that the interface remains clean and professional under all conditions.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given no data is returned from the API
When the data grid attempts to load
Then the system must display an empty state UI

Given the dataset is small enough to fit on a single page
Then the system must hide all pagination controls.

User Story Summary: System Performance and Error Handling
User Story Description:
As a system administrator, I want to ensure the application remains stable under heavy data loads and handles API failures gracefully so that the user experience is not negatively impacted.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given a large dataset (e.g., 500+ rows
When navigating pages
Then system performance should remain stable with no degradation

Given the Backend API fails during a request
Then the system must display a graceful error message rather than crashing or showing a broken state.

User Story Description:
As a Cloud Administrator, I want to access the AWS-specific link from the Vcloudsmart main dashboard so that I can view and manage AWS-related cloud resources.

# 🎨 Exhaustive Figma Design Review Report

## 📊 Overview & Design System Audit
- **Total Figma Pages / Frames Analyzed**: 1
- **Design System Consistency Rating**: 74%
- **Executive Summary**: The provided document contains a full desktop wireframe/spec frame (`1440 x 1024`) paired with an adjacent Design System documentation panel. While structural sectioning (Header, Navigation, Banner, Top Menu, Sidebar, Content) is documented with explicit pixel height and width callouts, there are significant discrepancies between the documented Design System tokens and their implementation in the main layout. Major issues include 8px grid grid height violations, typography hierarchy misuse, spelling/copywriting typos, token mislabeling in the color palette, and unmapped banner components.

---

### 📄 Figma Page / Frame 1: FRAME 1440 x 1024 (Guru99 Demo Site / Mercury Tours Spec)
- **Source**: Figma Image Specification Frame (`FRAME 1440 x 1024`)
- **Compliance Status**: MINOR DESIGN ADJUSTMENT

```
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| FRAME 1440 x 1024                                                                 |
| +-------------------------------------------------------------------------------+ |
| | HEADER (120px) : Logo Block (320px) | Leaderboard Ad Banner (728px)           | |
| +-------------------------------------------------------------------------------+ |
| | NAVIGATION BAR (60px) : Selenium, Insurance, Agile, Bank, Security, etc.      | |
| +-------------------------------------------------------------------------------+ |
| | BANNER (90px) : "one cool summer ARUBA"                                       | |
```
